items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I saw Al Cohn there too.

ctx.x: Lake. Thank you for correcting me. I stand to be corrected. I don’t know why I said River. Lake Avenue. That’s 35 years ago I worked for Doug Duke’s.
I saw Al Cohn there too.
